mission.headline: Mission
mission.text: In response to the ongoing erosion of individual financial freedoms and the increasing threats to privacy and autonomy, this foundation seeks to support and fund open source projects that not only elucidate these issues but also tackle them by providing practical tools.
theses.headline: The Vexl Foundation believes in three basic theses:
theses.1: Without the freedom to transact, we have no other rights.
theses.2: Technology should be used to empower individuals, not to control them.
theses.3: Everyone has the right to free choice, self-determination and privacy.
structure.headline: Why Foundation + LLC?
structure.vexl.text: The Foundation seeks to collaborate with other organizations and individuals who share the vision of a free and open financial world.
structure.donate.headline: Contribute to our mission
structure.satoshi.headline: Our gift to community
structure.satoshi.text: Vexl is a gift from SatoshiLabs for the entire bitcoin community. You can take part in supporting the mission by sending us some sound money.
board.headline: Board
board.text: We are cypherpunks and reformers, creating open-source solutions to empower individuals and protect their privacy.
